desc: Enumerate all non-empty subsets of the target array and precompute their LCM values (divide out gcd before multiplying).
For each nums value and each subset, compute cost = next multiple of LCM at or above nums[i] minus nums[i].
Implement bitmask DP over target coverage with per-element snapshot to prevent reuse.
Apply candidate reduction (keep m+1 cheapest elements per subset) to bound DP work.
Handle edge cases: cost 0 when already a multiple, duplicate target values, and full-mask return.
